contamination.name: ATI, Keeper Of The Heart Arena

singleSource.name: Manage Allocation Matrix at Network Gates
Defeat Terror of the Ledge without taking damage
Visit Network Gates before boss encounters
Reach the top of Haven via Bell Tower
Climb gloom waterfall in The Canopy
Convert Liquid Nacre to Solid Nacre
Use Nacre Basin before Egis if low on health
Climb to the top using Hairpin
Slide down icy floor and cross red grass ground
Find the hole in the ground and drop down
Use elevator to return to Shii and unlock the map
Defeat gauntlet and open Container for Protective Overlay
Explore hidden path to reach Blocked-off Dome
Use Crystalliser to condense Nacre Droplets
Heal at Nacre Basin before boss
Find Old Core in Mechanical Remains
Watch essential tips for Mio: Memories in Orbit
Find the Crystallizer Robot near The Severed Spine
Head West Past Enemy and Dwellings
Find Chest and Complete Challenge Fight
Bring Passport to elevator and ascend
Use cross-area abilities to unlock blocked paths
Locate the Torn Overseer in each area
Use Network Gate to save and update map
Reach out to the other Pearls
Watch for more Memories in Orbit content
Defeat ATI, Keeper Of The Heart
Network Gates act as loadout-swap hubs within The Vessel, allowing Modification equip/unequip without changing zones.
Returning to a Network Gate (save point) updates the map with newly explored routes.
Player returns to Network Gates to swap or combine Modifications; acts as a modification hub.
Nacre Basin is hidden behind an icy gate just above the Egis arena
Progress after defeating Egis; climb to the top using Hairpin, then enter the hole in the left wall
Player progresses from The Beginning into The Severed Spine as part of the opening path
Player progresses from The Severed Spine to Dwellings #6
Player routes south/south-east from The Severed Spine through the Feral Undergrowth.
Circling back east through Feral Undergrowth leads to an accessible Crystallizer Robot near The Severed Spine.
Head west past the enemy and dwellings to reach the chest/challenge fight area
Return to elevator near game start with Aviary's Passport and ascend to level one (Spine Floor)
Alternate progression path eastward through Haven; late-game route that also eventually yields Dodge without the passport shortcut
Main story progression path leads from The Dwellings into Metropolis.
Shortcut unlocked after defeating ACAT, allowing fast travel back to The Spine.
Fast travel between the two main exploration areas
Warp connection unlocked between a Network Gate and The Spine once the Torn Overseer for that area has been found.
Phase transition during ATI, Keeper Of The Heart boss fight shifts the battle from the physical crystalline cavern to an abstract white void
